source.title: Cavite Fisheries Preliminary Situation Report: 3rd Quarter 2025
source.provider: Philippine Statistics Authority, Cavite Provincial Statistical Office
source.accessStatus: Official PSA landing page and linked seven-page PDF text reviewed through web access on 2026-10-26; direct local PDF download was blocked by the source site's anti-bot challenge; no local copy retained.
source.reuseStatus: The landing-page footer states a site-wide CC BY 4.0 default unless otherwise stated; attachment-specific reuse terms were not independently confirmed. No figure, chart, or full table is reproduced.

scope.sourceMethodContext: The release reports PSA quarterly fisheries-survey estimates and defines inland municipal fisheries as municipal fishing activities conducted in inland bodies of water. Technical notes say data are collected through interviews and supplemented with secondary data.
scope.waterbodyResolution: No river, lake, dam, marsh, station, municipality, landing site, or sample-level location is assigned to the inland production categories.
scope.taxonomicResolution: The release uses the aggregate label Tilapia, the group label Other fishes, and Blue crab (Alimasag); it gives no scientific names, vouchers, or diagnostic identification method. Blue crab is not a fish.

reportedProduction.note: The three displayed category values total 9.07 tonnes; the report labels the subsector total 9.08 tonnes and notes that details may not add up due to rounding or statistical disclosure control.

decision.use: Province-level inland-fisheries statistical context and a lead for requesting more detailed, authorized QIFS metadata; do not assign to a named waterbody or treat production categories as a species checklist.

limitations: The statistics are preliminary province-level production estimates for one quarter and are not a waterbody survey or complete inland checklist.
No reporting site, household, catch origin, specimen, event date, or river/lake assignment is supplied for the displayed categories.
Tilapia is not resolved to species; Other fishes is an aggregate; Blue crab is not a fish.
Production quantities do not establish occurrence, current presence, local abundance, diet, catchability, legal access, safety, or geometry.
The report separates inland municipal fisheries from aquaculture, but the release does not document the individual production origin needed for a locality-specific wild-capture assertion.
The website's general CC BY 4.0 footer was observed; the specific PDF attachment's reuse status requires confirmation before publication or data redistribution.
nextAction: Continue the inland-waterbody inventory and seek primary survey or specimen evidence with named rivers/lakes, sampling stations, dates, identification basis, and reuse terms. If useful, request an authorized, non-identifying QIFS breakdown by waterbody or reporting geography; do not send a request without the project owner's choice.
